```python
# Hypothesis: candidate neurons encode self-reconsideration rather than simply final-answer or thinking-boundary tokens.
probe_components=[(22,315),(29,49),(27,1365),(26,8237),(21,7947),(27,4896),(30,4486),(31,142)]
D={}
E=load_original('model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight')
probe_words=['Wait','wait','But','However','Alternatively','Perhaps','Maybe','Actually','check','verify',
             'again','repeat','Therefore','Thus','Hence','So','answer','solution','correct','contradiction',
             'calculate','Let','Then','Compute','Simplify','Since','Suppose','Recall','Finally',
             '</think>','<think>','\\boxed','0','1','2','+','-','=','\n']
word_ids={}
for w in probe_words:
    enc=tok.encode(w,add_special_tokens=False)
    ii=enc.ids if hasattr(enc,'ids') else enc
    if len(ii)==1: word_ids[w]=ii[0]
ei=E[list(word_ids.values())]
for l,j in probe_components:
    if l not in D: D[l]=load_original(f'model.language_model.layers.{l}.mlp.down_proj.weight')
    col=D[l][:,j]
    scores=(ei@col).numpy()
    order=np.argsort(scores)
    print((l,j),"col norm",round(float(col.norm()),3),"act cut/long-correct",
          round(float(M[bad,l,j].mean()),4),round(float(M[ctrl,l,j].mean()),4),
          "high",[(list(word_ids)[k],round(float(scores[k]),3)) for k in order[-5:][::-1]],
          "low",[(list(word_ids)[k],round(float(scores[k]),3)) for k in order[:5]])
for pid in ['aime_2006-I-15','aime_2018-II-11','aime_2008-I-11','math_train_prealgebra_593']:
    i=ids.index(pid)
    print("\nTRACE",pid)
    for frac in [.1,.3,.6,.9]:
        t=S[i]['text']; start=int(frac*len(t))
        print(frac,t[start:start+280].replace('\n',' '))
```
